description: This file provides utility functions for interacting with an app deployments API, including fetching project names by project ID and aggregating deployment status counts with server and client-side fallbacks.

methods.name: fetchProjectNameByProjectId
methods.description: Fetches a project name given a project ID by querying the deployments API.

methods.name: fetchDeploymentStatusCounts
methods.description: Fetches deployment status counts, attempting server-side retrieval first, then falling back to client-side aggregation.
